title: In the motel glass
logline: The night desk again, and in the glass door: a reflection of a clerk at the desk, drawing. He's in the glass, not at the desk. The desk itself is drawn empty.

panels.composition: The motel's glass door at night from inside, and in it the reflection of the desk behind the viewer: a man in a maroon polo bent over a pad. The desk itself, at the page's edge, is empty. Only the reflection has him.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a motel's glass door at night reflecting a desk behind the viewer where a man in a maroon polo bends over a pad, while the actual desk at the page's edge is empty, no words
image.notes: He is in the reflection and not at the desk. Both drawn.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: In the glass, not at the desk.
